nl.title: WordPress URL omzetten van http naar https
nl.excerpt: Zet WordPress-URL’s op HTTPS na SSL: siteurl/home en force redirect.
nl.bodyHtml:
Na Let’s Encrypt moet WP zelf op https:// staan om mixed content en redirect-loops te voorkomen.

Voorbereiding

  • Geldig SSL-certificaat
  • wp-admin toegang

Stappen

  1. Installeer SSL in DirectAdmin
  2. Force SSL / redirect in panel indien beschikbaar
  3. WP → Instellingen → Algemeen: beide URL’s op https://
  4. Of pas toe via Installatron/WP-CLI search-replace
  5. Purge caches
  6. Test

Controleren

  • Hangslot ok
  • Geen mixed content op kernpagina’s

Tip: Check elementor/CDN caches apart.

Let op: Alleen .htaccess redirect zonder URL-opties in WP geeft vaak login-loops.

Kom je er na deze stappen niet uit? Open een ticket bij TripleZero iT via het klantenpanel. Vermeld hostname, DirectAdmin-gebruikersnaam (geen wachtwoord), domein en wat je al probeerde.

Gerelateerd: letsencrypt-da; installatron.

en.title: WordPress URL omzetten of http to https
en.excerpt: WordPress URL omzetten of http to https: backup, wp-admin, clear cache, verify.
en.bodyHtml:
For “WordPress URL omzetten of http to https” you work in WordPress (/wp-admin) on TripleZero iT hosting. Take a backup first; then change carefully and clear caches.

Preparation

  • Installatron or panel backup (files + database)
  • Login to /wp-admin of the correct site
  • DirectAdmin File Manager if wp-admin will not open

Steps

  1. Create a backup via Installatron or DirectAdmin.
  2. Sign in to /wp-admin.
  3. Apply the change in the correct menu: Plugins, Themes, Settings, Users, Media or WooCommerce.
  4. Save. On a critical error: via File Manager temporarily rename wp-content/plugins or activate a default theme.
  5. Clear page cache, object cache and CDN cache.
  6. Test the homepage, login and a critical flow (form or checkout).

Verify

  • No critical error
  • Change visible on the front end or in wp-admin

Tip: Change one plugin or theme at a time — faster rollback.

Note: Do not delete the uploads folder or database tables without a restore plan.

Still stuck? Open a ticket with TripleZero iT via the client panel. Include your domain name, what you already tried, and any exact error messages (text or screenshot).

Related: Installatron backup, PHP version, critical error.
